observation: Fresh main already excludes credential-like paths from cognitive context and tells synthesis providers not to touch secrets, but ChangesetStore.stage/apply did not enforce the same credential boundary. A direct stage request or a durably rewritten staged changeset could therefore reach the effect boundary for .env, credential, private-key or certificate-like paths.
changes: Reuse the existing repo-context isCredentialLikePath classifier at ChangesetStore.stage before any credential-like path is staged.
Recheck the same credential boundary during apply preflight after durable reload so persisted changeset rewriting cannot bypass staging policy.
Leave rollback semantics unchanged so an already-applied historical changeset can still restore its recorded preimage rather than being stranded.

verification.pre_fix_source_contract_replay: EXPECTED FAIL: stage/apply only enforced control-directory/path-shape boundaries; isCredentialLikePath was not present at either effect gate.
verification.focused_bounded_replay: PASS 6/6: .env, credentials.json, id_ed25519 and .p12 paths are rejected by the existing classifier-backed effect gate while ordinary source/document paths remain admissible.
verification.regression_contract: tests/changeset-credential-effect-boundary-integrity.test.mjs covers stage-time write/delete rejection and apply-time durable path rewriting before any workspace side effect.

truth_boundary: This cycle does not define a new secret taxonomy; it reuses the repository's existing credential-path classifier and moves that already-established boundary to the actual changeset effect gates.
